I need link building outreach/Digital PR expert for my two sites. I don't want to work SEO agencies cause my budget is limited, prefer only individual freelancers.

My requirements:
1) NO PBNS/LINK FARMS/COMMENTS/SOCIAL BOOKMARKING/ AND OTHER TYPES OF BACKLINKS 
2) Website must have minimum 1 years of age, DA/DR 20+, Traffic: 1000 minimum from google organic, no link spams on website, only relevant to my niche, dofollow backlink needed.
3) Again I need only niche relevant backlinsk to our site not any random site, and dofollow permanent backlink.
4) Want to secure atleast total 10 natural dofollow permanent backlinks each month for my both sites.

Before sending me proposal, share your link building outreach/digital pr strategy and your past work. 

Monthly Budget: 7000INR (good job will increase to further higher budget after one month successfull campaign)

Remember, I don't have big budgets for link building and can't pay for indivisual backlinks so you have to vet and find websites that offer backlinks in terms of genuine help.


Note: It will be permanent job for 2-5 years and won't remove you if you can do in my budget and give good results, not those shady spreadsheets backlinks these SEO agencies gives.

Thanks!
